Hence, pleadings related to Petition No. 13/MP/2024 are covered in detail with analysis and decision applicable to both cases. **9.** After hearing the learned counsel for the Petitioner and the representative of the WRLDC, the Commission admitted the Petition and directed as follows: # ** Submissions of Petitioner TPREL in compliance with the RoP for hearing dated 24.01.2024: ** **14.** The Petitioner, in its Rejoinder vide affidavit dated 12.02.2024, has mainly submitted as follows: - (a) The Provisional FTC/CON-4 was granted to those RE projects that fall under Part-II and Part- III of the Working Group Report, 2022, i.e., those that will achieve commercial operation after the issuance of the Working Group Report, 2022. The Petitioner’s Project has achieved commercial operation before the issuance of the Working Group Report, 2022. The Petitioner’s Project was not amongst the projects that were discussed in the CEA meetings. The fact that the Petitioner’s Project was not amongst the 20 RE projects in question is not even disputed by WRLDC in its Reply. - (c) On 23.03.2023, WRLDC issued a letter to the SPPD and its SPDs (including the Petitioner) wherein WRLDC itself, in the context of the present case, relied upon Clause 6 of Part-I of the Working Group Report, 2022 requested the SPPD & its SPDs (including the Petitioner) to take immediate action and resolve the same. - (d) The Petitioner’s Project ought to fall under Clause 6 of Part-I of the Working Group Report, 2022. Part-II & Part-III of the Working Group Report, 2022 are only applicable to those Projects that have applied for CON-4 or will apply for CON-4 after the issuance of the Working Group Report, 2022. **16.** The learned counsel for the Petitioners and the representative of WRLDC made detailed submissions in the matter. Considering the submissions made by the learned counsels for the parties, the Commission directed the parties to file their respective written submissions. The Commission further directed the Petitioner and the Respondent, WRLDC, to file the following information: - (a) What actions have been taken by the Petitioner to comply with the noncompliances observed in the WRLDC`s letter dated 23.3.2023? # ** Submission of Petitioner TPREL in compliance with the RoP for hearing dated 14.02.2024: ** # ** Supplementary Submissions by WRLDC on implementation of directions by Commission in orders dated 20.02.2024 in IA No. 6/2024 in Petition No. 13/MP/2024 and IA No. 12/2024 in Petition No. 39/MP/2024 ** # ** Submissions of Petitioner TPREL in compliance with the RoP for hearing dated 26.12.2024: ** # ** Submission of Petitioner ENGIE in compliance with the RoP for hearing dated 26.12.2024 in Petition No. 39/MP/2024: ** **31.** Learned counsel for the Petitioners submitted that the Petitioners have installed the additional reactive power compensation devices in compliance with the Working Group Report, 2022, and have also placed on record the details thereof in the above compliance affidavits. With regard to compensation towards the loss incurred by the Petitioner on account of the curtailment instructions issued by WRLDC the Petitioners in Petition No. 13/MP/2024 & 39/MP/2024 may, either be permitted to amend the prayer(s) so as to include the prayer for compensation or be granted a liberty to approach the Commission to file separate Petitions in this regard. **33.** Considering the submissions made by the learned counsels for the parties, the Commission reserved the Petition Nos. 13/MP/2024 and 39/MP/2024 for Order. **37.** We have considered the submission of the Petitioners and the Respondents, and also the documents placed on the record. The following issues arise for our consideration: **56.** It is evident from the above-mentioned list that the RE generating stations of the Petitioners in Petition No. 13/MP/2024 (TPREL), as well as in Petition No. 39/MP/2024 (Electro Solaire), do not appear in the above-mentioned list. WRLDC has clarified that though the list does not include the name of the Petitioner, the spirit of the direction is to be applied equally to all those generators who have obtained FTC by giving an undertaking, but subsequently have not complied with the CEA Technical Standards. WRLDC stated that for the same non-compliance, any relief to the Petitioner while other SPDs are subjected to restriction results in unequal treatment. Hence, the WRLDC extended/ applied the schedule restriction to the Petitioners also. **60.** We note that during the proceedings under the present Petitions, the Petitioners have raised the issue regarding compensation towards the loss incurred by the Petitioners on account of the curtailment instructions issued by WRLDC, which is beyond the scope of the present Petition, and accordingly, we decline to pass any directions in this regard. **61.** The Petition No. 13/MP/2024 and 39/MP/2024 are disposed of in terms of the above.
